WITH matched_units AS (
  SELECT
    sf.sentreg,
    tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
    sf.instownpct AS ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
units_with_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    sentreg,
    order_type_mix,
    ownership,
    AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix) AS mix_baseline,
    AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_average
  FROM matched_units
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM units_with_baselines
  WHERE ownership > overall_average
)
SELECT
  AVG(ownership) AS average_ownership,
  AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS average_ownership_to_mix_baseline,
  AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM kept_units;
